en.title: We know how to govern, there is direction, work and results

en.title: Pyrotechnic explosion leaves one dead and six wounded
en.summary: A pyrotechnic explosion resulted in one fatality and six injuries.

stories.title: Se extienden a 50 ciudades protestas contra crisis de vivienda en España

en.title: Housing crisis protests extend to 50 cities in Spain
en.summary: Tens of thousands of people in 50 Spanish cities demonstrated against the housing crisis, demanding rent reductions, expropriations of properties held by investment funds, and indefinite rental contracts.

stories.title: Hoy, elección presidencial en Brasil; Lula y Bolsonaro lideran preferencias

en.title: Brazil's presidential election today; Lula and Bolsonaro lead preferences
en.summary: Brazil holds a presidential election with incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and far-right candidate Flávio Bolsonaro as leading contenders, with over 150 million eligible voters.

stories.title: México es humillado por Estados Unidos en el Clásico de Concacaf; Rafa Márquez sigue sin conocer la victoria

en.title: Mexico is humiliated by United States in Concacaf Classic; Rafa Márquez remains winless
en.summary: Mexico's national team suffered a significant defeat to the United States in a Concacaf Classic match at State Farm Stadium in Glendale, with defensive errors in both penalty areas proving costly for coach Rafa Márquez.

en.title: "Chucky" Lozano ruled out of friendly against United States
en.summary: Mexican footballer Hirving Lozano has been excluded from tonight's friendly match against the United States and will leave the team's training camp tomorrow.

en.title: United States 3-0 Mexico LIVE; follow here the minute by minute of the friendly match
en.summary: The United States defeated Mexico 3-0 in a friendly soccer match.

stories.title: Deja explosión de pirotecnia un muerto y 7 heridos en Edomex

en.title: Fireworks explosion leaves one dead and 7 injured in Edomex
en.summary: A truck carrying fireworks exploded in Temascaltepec, Edomex, killing one woman and injuring seven others.

stories.title: "​Aguascalientes avanza con rumbo, trabajo y resultados"; Tere Jiménez presenta su Cuarto Informe de Gobierno

en.title: "Aguascalientes advances with direction, work and results"; Tere Jiménez presents her Fourth Government Report
en.summary: The governor of Aguascalientes presented her fourth government report in an event featuring an innovative format, highlighting her administration's main achievements.

stories.title: Así cerraron Lula y Flávio Bolsonaro sus campañas antes de la primera vuelta electoral en Brasil

en.title: How Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro closed their campaigns before the first electoral round in Brazil
en.summary: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro concluded their campaign efforts ahead of Brazil's first round election on Sunday. If no candidate achieves over 50% of valid votes, the top two finishers will advance to a runoff.

stories.title: España vive protestas masivas por vivienda; 70,000 marchan en Madrid

en.title: Spain experiences massive housing protests; 70,000 march in Madrid
en.summary: Spain saw large-scale protests over housing affordability, with 70,000 people marching in Madrid amid concerns that tourism platforms and investment funds are driving up property prices and reducing residential housing availability.

stories.title: Estados Unidos despliega 500 militares en frontera con México; Marina activa operativo en Matamoros

en.title: United States deploys 500 military personnel on Mexico border; Navy activates operation in Matamoros
en.summary: The United States has deployed 500 military personnel to its border with Mexico as part of coordinated mirror operations between the two countries. Mexico has positioned 159 naval personnel, 11 vehicles, and two drones in the border zone.

stories.title: Slim, Fernández Carbajal y Servitje, entre los empresarios que más empleos generan

en.title: Slim, Fernández Carbajal and Servitje among businessmen generating the most jobs
en.summary: José Antonio Fernández Carbajal, Carlos Slim, and Daniel Servitje are behind some of the country's largest formal employment sources.

stories.title: México vs. Estados Unidos: así está el marcador económico entre los dos países

en.title: Mexico vs. United States: here's the economic scoreboard between the two countries
en.summary: Mexico and the United States maintain a commercial relationship exceeding 870 billion dollars, running parallel to a soccer match between their national teams.

stories.title: Un avión desaparece frente a la costa este de Estados Unidos

en.title: A plane disappears off the east coast of the United States
en.summary: A medical evacuation aircraft carrying six people vanished off the coast of Massachusetts while traveling from Bermuda to Boston.

stories.title: Lula da Silva y Flávio Bolsonaro se preparan para las elecciones en Brasil

en.title: Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro prepare for elections in Brazil
en.summary: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are concluding their election campaigns in Brazil, with polls indicating a runoff scheduled for October 25 and Trump's influence emerging as a key debate topic.

stories.title: El Brasil que viene: mercados, inversiones y nuevas alianzas

en.title: The Brazil that is coming: markets, investments and new alliances
en.summary: Regardless of election outcomes, Brazil's public finances, relationships with China, the United States and Europe, and investment regulations will determine opportunities and risks in Latin America's largest economy.
